title: Isolation of electrical supply before cleaning
learningOutcomes: Explain why isolation comes before any wet work.

instruction.heading: Why isolation comes first
instruction.body: Water and mains power do not mix. Before any wet work near a socket or appliance, the supply must be isolated at the switchboard and the person doing the work must confirm it is dead with a tester.

procedure: Isolate the circuit and test it.

commonErrors.error: Assuming a switch off means the circuit is dead.
commonErrors.prevention: Test the circuit before any contact.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: Electrical isolation is licensed work where the local rules say so.

qualityStandard: The circuit is tested dead before work starts.
